name: S2S-AI Subseasonal-to-Seasonal Forecasting Challenge
description: S2S-AI is a subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasting challenge focused on predicting climate and weather variables at lead times from weeks to months. It evaluates data-driven forecasting methods on operationally relevant horizons where predictability is limited and skill is challenging to extract.
evaluation_method: forecast skill metrics against ground truth, typically including anomaly correlation, RMSE, and related probabilistic or deterministic verification scores
notes: Challenge format may involve standardized test sets and leaderboard comparison; scores depend strongly on variable, region, and forecast horizon.
